description: Welcome to the official campaign site for John Ley, candidate for the Washington State Legislature. John is dedicated to bringing fiscally responsible and common-sense solutions to our community. Key issues include transportation improvements, supporting law enforcement, responsible spending, and enhancing education. Stay informed, get involved, and learn how you can support his campaign.
